settings.title: Club management
settings.subheading: A platform designed to support and scale your club.

settings.text: Generic gym software isn't designed for the nuances of fencing. Piste is built exclusively to empower your club’s growth and success. Leave the back office behind and focus on where you belong—the piste.

settings.title: Schedule classes
settings.text: Effortlessly organize class schedules and empower your members to manage their own memberships, class registrations, and open fencing times—all in one place.

settings.title: Reserve coaching
settings.text: Give athletes the control to book and manage private lessons independently. They can schedule, reschedule, and view coach availability with ease.

settings.title: Automated billing
settings.text: Automate your billing process to maximize cash flow. Set up upfront charges and recurring payments for coaching, keeping your finances streamlined.

settings.title: Family management
settings.text: Simplify membership for families. Parents can manage their entire family’s memberships through a single profile, with automated federation registration updates.

settings.title: Gear discounts
settings.text: Take advantage of exclusive wholesale discounts on fencing gear. Piste members get access to deep savings for both club use and resale, thanks to our optimized supply chain.

settings.subtitle: Goals
settings.title: Fencing ecosystem
settings.text: Fencing produces valuable data that remains disconnected. Piste's vision is to unify class rosters, practice performance, tournament results, federation memberships, and rankings into one platform—Giving coaches and athletes insights that drive engagement and growth at all levels of sport.

settings.subtitle: Vision
settings.title: Roadmap
settings.text: Our roadmap is evolving, and we welcome your input to help shape our beta features. We're committed to launching with a focused scope to ensure we deliver the right solutions from the start. Your feedback on our public roadmap will be invaluable as we move forward.

Our beta release will be invite-only -- allowing us to provide a tailored onboarding experience and address the unique needs of clubs both large and small. Join our waitlist below to be notified as soon as onboarding begins.

settings.title: How will Piste be priced?
settings.text: We understand that every club is unique, so a one-size-fits-all pricing model doesn’t work. Piste will be competitively priced compared to typical gym software, with a generous free tier to support smaller clubs.

settings.title: How many clubs will be included in the beta?
settings.text: Our beta phase will be highly focused, including fewer than five clubs. Join the waitlist to be notified when onboarding begins, and we’ll work together to see if it’s the right fit for your club.

settings.title: What features will be included in the beta?
settings.text: We’re refining the feature set for our initial launch, focusing on a small subset of key features to deliver value early on. Check out our roadmap to share your feedback and suggest features for future releases.

settings.title: What’s better: a single tempo or two tempo?
settings.text: Why choose two when you can win in one?

settings.title: Are there alternatives to Piste?
settings.text:
We found that most small to medium clubs do not have any specialized management software. However, large clubs often use ZenPlanner, MindBody, and Acuity.

These systems are expensive and come packed with many features that fencing clubs don't use. The only service we've found tailored for fencing clubs is Schedule Fencing.

settings.title: How can I get in touch?
settings.text: We’d love to hear from you! Feel free to reach us at support@fencing.club.
